name: menu-popover
description: Shared popup primitive. customJS.MenuPopover.open(entries, opts) renders a desktop-anchored dropdown / mobile bottom-sheet overlay appended to document.body — the DRY extraction of the _openLauncher / _openMoreMenu overlay that space-nav-buttons, project-nav-buttons and trip-nav-buttons each duplicated. Single close() teardown removes the overlay AND the capture-phase Escape listener (no listener leak); dismiss on backdrop tap / Escape / same-anchor re-open toggle; danger rows color the label var(--text-error); { section } marker entries render muted uppercase group headers. Powers the Go launcher, hub menus, and per-row task menus.
